objective: Test whether official SPY primary-listing opening-auction residual buy pressure continues during the first cash-session hour strongly enough for a long-UPRO/cash strategy to substantially outperform SPY after observed execution.
research_history_warning: Many prior hypotheses exposed the researcher to 2021-2026 market outcomes. This exact actual-imbalance rule is new, but all historical partitions are secondary evidence and any survivor requires prospective paper validation.

distinctness.why_not_a_repeat: V34 uses the official ARCX.PILLAR SPY opening-auction imbalance message. It does not infer auction state from OHLCV, displayed depth, or last-sale flow, and it deliberately omits the structurally costly inverse sleeve.

data.secondary_execution: Databento EQUS.MINI UPRO TBBO, using the pre-trade BBO on the first eligible trade from one through sixty seconds after each scheduled boundary
data.excluded_sessions: Dates marked degraded in the corresponding Databento dataset-condition file

signal.message_selection: For each session, select the latest SPY auction_type M message whose ts_event is strictly before 09:29:00 ET.
signal.eligibility: ref_price and ind_match_price are positive; paired_qty and total_imbalance_qty are positive; side is A or B.
signal.trade_state: Buy UPRO only when side is B. Side A and missing/ineligible states hold cash.
signal.rationale: A positive total imbalance with side B is unresolved deadline-bound buy pressure. Thresholds and price-path filters are intentionally omitted until the sign mechanism itself earns support.

execution.account: Start with $100 cash and deploy all available equity in fractional UPRO shares, reinvesting realized equity.
execution.entry: Observed UPRO ask at 09:31 ET on ARCX.PILLAR BBO-1m. Exact minute required; no forward fill.
execution.exit: Observed UPRO bid at 10:30 ET on ARCX.PILLAR BBO-1m. Exact minute required; no forward fill.
execution.cash_settlement_warning: The economic simulation assumes daily redeployment. Literal settled-cash constraints require separate operational review before paper or live use.

development.holdout_lock: Do not calculate any 2024-2026 post-signal return unless every development gate passes.

requirements: minimum two trades per calendar week
positive fixed-notional P&L in 2024 and 2025 separately
ending cash at least 110 percent of same-period price-only SPY
positive after one extra cent per share at both fills
positive after removing five best sessions
positive on both reference-gap sign subsets

diagnostic_extension.lock: Open only if development and secondary holdout both pass. It is diagnostic, not pristine prospective evidence.

placebos.sell_side_sign_flip: Trade UPRO on eligible side A sessions using the same execution clock.
placebos.previous_session_signal: Trade UPRO today when the prior eligible session's frozen state was side B. No current-session auction state is used.

reference_gap_identification: Define pre-open reference gap as ref_price divided by prior session SPY close minus one. The actual strategy must have positive fixed-notional P&L in both nonnegative-gap and negative-gap subsets.
parameter_policy: One sign, one 09:29 cutoff, one UPRO actuator, one 09:31 entry, one 10:30 exit, and one implementation. No post-result threshold, timing, sign, stop, actuator, or sleeve repair.
